title: first_upgradeable returns -1 on an asset missing its id instead of continuing to later candidates
detail: A ragged asset lacking id that is the first affordable non-damaged upgrade makes first_upgradeable return -1, falling through to WORK SHIFT and skipping later valid upgrades; the sibling oldest_damaged_repairable guards exactly this.
recommended_fix: Mirror the sibling: compute `var asset_id := int(asset.get("id", -1))` and `if asset_id < 0: continue` before returning, so a missing id skips to the next candidate instead of ending the search.

title: Touch proxy emits pressed on press-down only; no release-inside / drag-off-cancel path
evidence:
func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed \
			and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		pressed.emit()
detail: It fires on button-down. A press-down then drag-off and release (which a Button under the default ACTION_MODE_BUTTON_RELEASE treats as a canceled click) still fires here, so the save-wiping NEW GAME proxy has no cancel path.
recommended_fix: Track the in-proxy left press and emit pressed on left-button release only while still inside the rect; drop presses whose release lands outside, mirroring Button click semantics.
